issues.quote: It had stopped. That is all I know of it. It stopped with its master.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator, its stopping, or any time of death.
issues.misreading: A solver could take 'it stopped with its master' as placing the regulator's stopping at the moment of Aurèle's death, and so treat the regulator as a time anchor the sheet never gives.
